results.name: 3. Procedure / inclusions
results.question: What is included in the out-patient adenocarcinoma cancer treatment package at ITC?
results.answer: The out‑patient adenocarcinoma cancer treatment package at ITC includes daily visits for therapies without overnight stay, weekly comprehensive lab work (CBC, blood chemistry, immunology, kidney function, metabolic and coagulation panels, specific tumor markers, and urinalysis), one prescribed imaging study (X‑ray, ultrasound, or CT scan), all core alternative therapies listed for the 3‑week program, two health‑focused meals per day during treatment hours, standard medications as discussed on admission, and one follow‑up consultation with an ITC doctor three months after discharge.

citations.title: Alternative Adenocarcinoma Cancer Treatment Package in Tijuana, Mexico by ITC
citations.heading: Included in the Out-Patient Program ($18,995 USD)
citations.quote:
The Out-patient program is designed for patients that can come in and out daily to receive therapies at our medical center not needing to stay overnight.
Weekly Comprehensive Lab Work: CBC, blood chemistry, immunology assessment, kidney function, metabolic and coagulation panels (TP/TPT), specific tumor markers, and urinalysis.
Prescribed Imaging: One X-ray, ultrasound, or CT scan of one area as directed by your ITC physician.
Core Therapies: All alternative treatments listed as standard within the 3-week program.
Nutritional Support: Two health-focused meals provided daily during treatment hours.
Medications: Standard medications included in the out-patient protocol (discussed upon admission).
Follow-up Care: One post-discharge consultation with an ITC doctor after 3 months.
